data.text: Our College won the 3rd place in a Debate Competition at the district level, organized by the Moratuwa University Tamil Literary Union. Congratulations to our students and appreciation to the teachers who trained them.
Inauguration Ceremony of St Patrick's Soccer Academy

St. Patrick's College Soccer Academy was inaugurated on Saturday, 29th June 2024. Teachers-in-charge of the College football teams, students and old boys were present at the inauguration ceremony. The Chief Guest for the event was  Mr & Mrs. Kingsley Sebestiyampillai, former cricket & football player of SPC and the special guests were Mr. R. Nitharshan, National Football Player and Mr. G.Ranjith Thevarajan, Secretary of  Patrician Sports Club.  The academy is sponsored by an old Patrician Mr. Pirasantharajah. The Patrician Community is grateful to him. At the end of the event there was a friendly football match between Passaiyoor St Antony's Junior Team and SPC Under 12 team.
Sri Lanka Tennis Association organized 'Cool Tennis Tournament' on 18th,19th & 20th May 2024. Mas. R. Nekethan was the Champion in the Boys' Singles.
